Crumb & Co. Bakery @crumbandco

We opened our doors five years ago this Saturday! To say thank you, the first 50 customers will get a free cinnamon roll with any coffee. Our owner, Lena, will also be giving a short bread-baking demo at 11 A.M. Come early, because last year the rolls were gone by 9:30!

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the post?
options: A. To advertise a new coffee shop
B. To announce a celebration at the bakery
C. To hire new bakers for the weekend
D. To change the bakery's opening hours
questions.explanation: The bakery says "We opened our doors five years ago this Saturday! To say thank you..." and lists special events for the day.

questions.stem: Why does the bakery tell people to come early?
options: A. The demo starts before the bakery opens.
B. Lena will only be there in the morning.
C. The free rolls may run out quickly.
questions.explanation: Only "the first 50 customers" get a roll, and "last year the rolls were gone by 9:30," so arriving late may mean missing out.
